name: Misty
author: myshzzx
description: Misty from Typora, made over for Textus: soft green-to-blue headings, numbered sections and gentle callouts, one file that follows light and dark. After Misty by E-Tiger Studio (MIT), with ideas from VLOOK.

zh.description: 由 Typora 主题 Misty 改造（E-Tiger Studio, 2017-2020, MIT），同时参考 VLOOK：绿蓝渐变的标题、带编号的章节和柔和的提示块，一个文件跟随浅色与深色。
